title: Fixed Long Lever and Open Side Baling Press
description: One complete newly authored static farm baling-press appearance. A deep rectangular empty chamber on one broad grounded base has full thick floor and three tall walls, with one whole front unloading gate fixed outward on a real full hinge. Two high rear timber posts and crossbeam carry a single long inclined hand lever with transverse grip. A full square ram and raised rectangular platen remain inside the chamber, guided between two separated cheeks with a visible fixed retaining pin. Unlike the round slatted fruit press, there is no screw, liquid tray or circular basket. Unlike the small C-throat rack press, there is a deep full rectangular loading chamber and large outward unloading gate, not a toothed ram or pinion. No parts reused from old machinery. One static model zero scenes; empty. No actual compression, bale production, hinge travel, mechanical advantage, pinch safety, manufacture, stability or load claim.
